## Getting started

Click HERE to claim your repo for this assignment.

First, open the R Markdown document `hw-01.Rmd` and Knit it. Make sure it compiles without errors. The output will be in the `.md` file with the same name.

```{r}
daily_rides <- read_csv("../../data/bikeshare/day.csv") %>%
  mutate(workingday = as.factor(workingday))
```

```{r}
daily_rides %>% glimpse()
```

```{r}
daily_rides %>% 
  gf_point(registered ~ dteday, color = ~ workingday) %>% 
  gf_smooth()
```

Make a similar plot showing the how the number of rides varies with temperature.

```{r}
daily_rides %>%
  gf_point(registered ~ temp, color = ~ workingday) %>% 
  gf_smooth()
```
